name: Momoe Eruru
source:
Class: 2-A
Favorite food: Trendy cakes and crepes
Hobbies: Gaming (anything goes), watching the protagonist, listening to music
Troubles: Doesn't get wet easily.

A top idol and member of the school's drama club alongside [url=/c78241]Yuuya[/url]. She is an honest, friendly and bright girl who gained quickly popularity as an idol and has now done wide variety of jobs from gravure idoling to starring in TV dramas. She loves hugging Yuuya whom she's obviously in love with, but easily get jealous when the other girls are around him.

She is good friends with [url=/c8472]Hikari[/url] and [url=/c8466]Momiji[/url].
